name: Lavender Haze
description: A slow, weightless world of soft focus and late-afternoon light, where nothing needs to be rushed.
prompt_explore: Collect five things around you that feel weightless and photograph each one in soft natural light.
prompt_digital_art: Paint a sky that fades from lavender to blush, with one small floating island drifting through it.
prompt_poster: Design a poster titled Slow Down using a single blurred photograph and generous letter spacing.
prompt_presentation: Use soft gradient backgrounds, one calm image per slide and plenty of empty space around each idea.
prompt_scrapbook: Layer tracing paper over pressed flowers and add a single line about the softest moment of your week.

name: Blue Hour Tide
description: The quiet stretch between day and night, when the sea goes still and thoughts get longer.
prompt_explore: Take a short walk at dusk and note three things that change colour as the light fades.
prompt_digital_art: Illustrate a still harbour at blue hour where the reflection is slightly different from the real scene.
prompt_poster: Create a poster with a deep blue gradient, one small light source and a quiet question as the headline.
prompt_presentation: Build slides on cool blue backgrounds with thin serif headings and one reflective quote to close.
prompt_scrapbook: Make a page of window views: sketch or photograph what you see from three different windows at dusk.

name: Sage Morning
description: Open windows, damp leaves and the first cup of tea. A world that feels like a deep breath.
prompt_explore: Spend ten minutes outside before breakfast and list every green thing you notice.
prompt_digital_art: Draw a sunlit kitchen windowsill with plants, a cup of tea and long morning shadows.
prompt_poster: Design a minimal poster around one leaf, a sage background and the words Begin Again.
prompt_presentation: Use muted green accents, natural photos and simple icons to keep every slide calm and clear.
prompt_scrapbook: Press a leaf from your neighbourhood and write down how your morning made you feel.

name: Blush Static
description: Faded photographs and old radio songs: a soft, slightly grainy world full of gentle memories.
prompt_explore: Find an old photo on your phone and recreate it today from the same angle.
prompt_digital_art: Paint a bedroom from memory with grainy textures, a soft pink glow and one object you have outgrown.
prompt_poster: Make a retro concert-style poster for a memory, with film grain and a faded pink palette.
prompt_presentation: Use polaroid-style image frames, a blush background and short handwritten-style captions.
prompt_scrapbook: Arrange ticket stubs, receipts or notes from one good day and tie the page together with ribbon.

name: Midnight Library
description: Lamplight, quiet pages and the hum of ideas. A world for thinking deeply and staying curious.
prompt_explore: Pick a topic you know nothing about and spend twenty minutes following your curiosity.
prompt_digital_art: Illustrate a reading nook lit by a single lamp, with stars visible through a tall window.
prompt_poster: Design a dark poster with lavender text that turns your favourite question into a headline.
prompt_presentation: Use dark slides with light text, one key idea per slide and small diagrams sketched in ink.
prompt_scrapbook: Create a page of quotes, doodles and margin notes from a book that made you think.

name: Golden Drift
description: Sunlight through dust and the feeling that something good is about to begin.
prompt_explore: Notice where sunlight lands in your home at three different times of the day.
prompt_digital_art: Paint an open road at golden hour, with light catching the dust in the air.
prompt_poster: Design a warm poster announcing something you are looking forward to, with a soft sun flare.
prompt_presentation: Use warm cream backgrounds, golden accents and photos with natural sunlight.
prompt_scrapbook: Make a hope page: three small things you want to happen soon, each with an image.

name: Velvet Thunder
description: Heavy clouds and electric air. A deep, dramatic world for feelings too big to sit still.
prompt_explore: Write the feeling down as fast as you can for two minutes, then circle the strongest word.
prompt_digital_art: Create a dramatic storm scene with deep purple clouds and one sharp line of light.
prompt_poster: Design a bold, high-contrast poster where one huge word fills most of the space.
prompt_presentation: Use deep plum backgrounds, strong contrast and one striking image to open each section.
prompt_scrapbook: Tear paper instead of cutting it and build a page from rough edges and dark textures.

name: Paper Moon
description: A pale, peaceful world for evenings alone. Lonely in a way that feels calm rather than sad.
prompt_explore: Sit somewhere quiet in the evening and describe the sky in exactly three sentences.
prompt_digital_art: Draw a small figure on a rooftop beneath a large pale moon, using only three colours.
prompt_poster: Design a minimalist poster with a paper-cut moon and a single line of lowercase text.
prompt_presentation: Use pale backgrounds, lots of empty space and one moon motif repeated across the slides.
prompt_scrapbook: Cut a moon from paper and surround it with small notes about things that comfort you.
